new_value: Adjudicated (Option A): the no-PIV rejection is a deliberate, documented deviation from RFC 8613 4.1.3.5. Normative text added to spec/06-security.md 15.3 (Observe Notifications — Partial IV Policy): fresh nonzero PIV per notification mandatory, receivers reject no-PIV notifications, foreign first-notification-omission senders are out of profile. C implementation must include fresh PIV per notification. 3exb (replay test) unblocked.
